title: Traumatic
summary: TRAUMAT'IC, adjective [Gr. a wound.] 1. Pertaining to or applied to wounds. 2. Vulnerary; adapted to the cure of wounds. TRAUMAT'IC, noun A medicine useful in the cure of wounds.
